posts.title: Church is for people who have problems?
posts.quote: You think it's for weak people. Church is for people who have problems. Is that what you think? You need to change your mind.
posts.onscreen: "You think church is for weak people." → "He's not offended by that."

captions.instagram:
"Church is for people who've got problems, isn't it?"

He said it out loud from the front. Not as an accusation. As a question he actually wanted answered.

If that's roughly what you think, you're not the first and nobody here is shocked.

Save this one for a day you're not sure.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Every decision, never for yourself
posts.quote: Every single decision you make should never be made for yourself. It should be made for Christ.
posts.onscreen: "Every decision you make" → "is not actually yours."

captions.instagram:
"Every single decision you make should never be made for yourself."

That lands hard if you've spent years being told to follow your gut and put yourself first.

He isn't saying you don't matter. He's saying you were handed a different set of instructions, and they're lighter than the ones you're carrying.

Send this to someone who overthinks every choice.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Change your mind
posts.quote: The kingdom is here. You have to change your mind. Have you changed your mind about the things of the kingdom?
posts.onscreen: "Repent" doesn't mean what you think → "It means change your mind."

captions.instagram:
Repent is a word that puts people off.

It sounds like a man with a sign. Shouting. Certain you're the problem.

Here's what it actually means: change your mind. That's the whole word. Think differently about who's running your life.

You can do that today, where you are, without telling anyone.

If you'd rather not do it alone, we gather Sundays at 11 in Manchester. No rush, no pressure.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

Stay quiet and intimidated, he says, and you stay intimidated.

posts.title: Every decision, not some decisions
posts.quote: Every decision, not some decisions. Not spiritual, not physical. All decisions you take give you an opportunity to enter the kingdom.

captions.instagram:
Most of us split life into two piles.

The spiritual bit, which God gets an opinion on. And the rest, which is ours.

He won't allow the split. Every decision, he says. Not some. Not spiritual, not physical. All of them.

Comment with the decision you're sitting on this week.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: You are the one carrying the Spirit
posts.care: MEMBER-FACING. Speaks to people already in the room about the worship leader and about carrying the Spirit. A stranger hearing this is being addressed as an insider. Caption leads on the half that includes them; the in-group beat is softened. Post to the existing-audience feed or Stories if in doubt.
posts.quote: You can make all the difference in this church if you determine to. You are the one that is carrying the Spirit.
posts.onscreen: "You're waiting for someone else to bring it." → "You brought it."

captions.instagram:
Most rooms have people waiting for someone else to make it good.

The person at the front. The person with the microphone. Someone more qualified, more sorted, more spiritual.

He says no. You're the one carrying it. Whoever's leading will do their part, but the room changes because of what you brought into it.

True of a church. True of a workplace, a family, a Tuesday.

Save this as a gut-check.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: What The King Asks
posts.quote: It's only looking back that you will see God. Not when you're in that situation.

captions.instagram:
Your boss asks you to lie.

Small one. Nobody gets hurt. Everyone else already said yes.

He doesn't pretend saying no is free. He says out loud that you might lose the job and struggle for school fees.

And then the line that stuck: it's only looking back that you'll see God. Not while you're standing in it.

Swipe through if you're weighing something up.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Treasure In A Field
posts.quote: For joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

captions.instagram:
A man is digging in a field that isn't his, and he finds treasure.

So he covers it back up, goes home, sells everything he owns, and buys one field that looks like every other field.

The word that matters is joy. He was glad to do it.

Then there's the other man. Same price. Walks away sorrowful, because all he could see was what he was giving up.

Save this and sit with which one sounds more like you.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Change Your Mind
posts.quote: I stopped walking in the wilderness of Christianity.

captions.instagram:
"Repent" is a word that puts people off.

It sounds like a man with a sign. Shouting. Certain you're the problem.

It actually means change your mind. That's the whole word.

He knows the day he did it: 27 July 1987. His phrase for what he left was "the wilderness of Christianity" — present every Sunday, never actually decided anything.

You can change your mind today, where you are, without telling anyone.

And if you'd rather not do it alone, we gather Sundays at 11 in Manchester.

🎬 From "Enter Into The Kingdom" — Rev Ifeayinchukwu Obi. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).
